name: Network Intrusion
description: External attacker gained a foothold — initial access, persistence, lateral movement.
initialKeyQuestions: What was the initial access vector?
Did the attacker move laterally, and to which hosts?
What privileges/accounts did the attacker obtain?
What was the attacker's objective (data theft, persistence, staging)?
Is the attacker still active in the environment?

initialNextSteps.action: Isolate compromised hosts and block known C2 infrastructure
Identify patient zero and the initial access vector
initialNextSteps.rationale: Root-cause the entry to prevent re-entry and scope the investigation

initialNextSteps.action: Map persistence across all touched hosts (services, scheduled tasks, registry, WMI)
initialNextSteps.rationale: Persistence is what makes an intrusion durable across reboots

initialNextSteps.action: Trace lateral movement from patient zero via RDP/SMB/WMI/WinRM
initialNextSteps.rationale: Determines the full set of hosts to rebuild
initialNextSteps.pointer: Windows Security 4624/4625/4688, Sysmon EID 3, 4624 logon type

synthesisHint: This is a network intrusion case — prioritize TA0001 Initial Access, TA0003 Persistence, TA0008 Lateral Movement, and TA0011 Command and Control.
